name: Sidford Recreation Ground Play Area
description: Play area on the recreation ground off Byes Lane in Sidford, run by East Devon District Council. The council's equipment supplier lists a Byes Lane play area here aimed at juniors and teenagers.

sources.label: East Devon District Council: play areas reopening (lists Recreation Ground, Sidford)

notConfirmed: Exact position (mapped from the Sidford Social Hall postcode on Byes Lane), equipment, under-7s provision, opening hours, toilets and parking. The council source is from 2020.
